newsitem.title: UK: UK shares open lower after Wall St profit-taking.
newsitem.headline: UK shares open lower after Wall St profit-taking.

text.p: Leading shares dipped in early trading on Wednesday after a disappointing performance on Wall Street overnight gave an opportunity for prices to be marked lower at the open, traders said. Shares retreated from yesterday's record closing high of 4,050.8 from the start, the FTSE 100 slipping 12.5 points to 4,038.3 early on.

Caution ahead of a string of key economic data, including jobs, earnings and PSBR data, due for release at 0830 GMT was also keeping interest subdued. Gilts nudged lower ahead of the figures but continued sterling strength was seen as supportive.
